name: Usuzumi Hatsumi
source: Hatsumi is a third-year at Eisui Girls' High School in Kagoshima Prefecture. She and the other members of Eisui's team are shrine maidens; she belongs to a branch family of the maidens' lineage. When it's her turn to play, she comes out in a ceremonial headdress and puts it back on afterwards. Hatsumi is quite energetic, but can be quite stubborn, still believing that she can make a hand while in the north seat after she was repeatedly blocked by Sae Usuzawa and warned by her teammates. She seems to care a lot about Komaki's well being as she doesn't want Komaki to overexert herself. Hatsumi loves to swim.
